units.source_text: 舞女依然紧闭双唇，凝视着一个方向。

en.t: The dancing girl still kept her lips tightly closed and stared in one direction.

units.source_text: 我抓住绳梯，回过头去，舞女想说声再见，可话到嘴边又咽了回去，然后再次深深地点了点头。

en.t: I grasped the rope ladder and looked back; the dancing girl seemed about to say goodbye, but swallowed the words before they came out, then bowed her head deeply once more.

units.source_text: 荣吉频频地摇动着我刚才送给他的那顶便帽。

en.t: Eikichi kept waving the flat cap I had just given him.

units.source_text: 直到船儿远去，舞女才开始挥舞她手中白色的东西。

en.t: Only after the boat had gone far away did the dancing girl begin to wave the white thing in her hand.
